list.label: Functions
list.description: Functional hierarchy of local government service areas
list.fullDescription:
The Function List is a hierarchy of service groups or activities that a public sector body performs to support information referenced at service group level, rather than in the detail of the full Service List. The high level headings are designed to meet similar objectives regardless of departmental or municipal responsibility. It transcends organisational structure and gathers similar activities into a logical collection that would be globally understood.
Use - to facilitate systems and human readable formats reference top level headings that collect services from differing organisations and countries in logical themed groupings. This enables local international sub-sets both to cross match and feature local services in order that comparisons may be drawn and services delivered to a common definition regardless of nationality.
list.accuracy: Content is based on the collaborative efforts of UK public sector officers and their suppliers. There are no guarantees on accuracy.
list.audience: Public sector officers and their suppliers responsible for service improvement.
list.completeness: Content is based on the collaborative efforts of UK public sector officers and their suppliers. There are no guarantees on completeness.
list.coverage: Developed for the UK public sector, but has wider relevance.
list.intendedLongevity: Indefinite. The list forms part of LG Inform Plus's Local Government Business Model started in 2002, funded by LG Inform Plus subscriptions.
list.provenance: Created by LG Inform Plus to support an evidence based framework for public sector service improvement.
list.rights: This list is licenced under the Open Government Licence and must be attributed to the LG Inform Plus programme.
list.timeliness: Updated roughly quarterly to align with service list.  See the modified date.
